notes.title: THE CARETAKER Releases tomorrow on the 30th of April.
notes.content:
Good day all!

THE CARETAKER finally releases tomorrow on the 30th of April.

I wanted to thank everyone that took part in the Steam Play Test run December to March. Your feedback has shaped (and then re-shaped) the game in so many ways. Thank you for your time, effort and patients. You're all in my super cool people book!

Just a few notes on the release build:

- Added support for 21:9 resolutions
- Added support for non standard refresh rates (for those who need it... thanks for pointing it out!)
- Rebalanced the weapons for a more "fair" feeling (sorry knife lovers :P)
- Leaderboards will be reset on Release to make it fair for everyone

I hope those who decide to play the game have a great experience. Know that you have my gratitude for picking it up and giving it a chance.

High fives to all!


Regards,


Squid Monkey Studios

notes.title: The Caretaker Changelog 0.1.09
notes.content:
Good Evening All,

Below are the changes/fixes made in 0.1.09:

- Player weapon stats have been tweaked for balance purposes.
- Player can no longer shoot when rolling
- War Pit map removed and exchanged for Military Base (this is due to the campaign narrative)
- Icons added to help players be aware of item identify from longer distances
- Maggot Mini Boss mechanics tweaked for a more fluid animation shift between states
- Non Mini Boss enemies now have their audio linked correctly to the Master SFX volume.

All in all not a massive update. My time has been focused on the main story narrative and making sure everything is wired up correctly. I will of course still be taking care of all reported issues and making adjustments to quality of life items... so keep those suggestions coming!

Again, thank you so much for all of your support, suggestions and queries. You input has been incredibly appreciated!

notes.title: The Caretaker Changelog 0.1.08
notes.content:
Good Evening All,

Below are the changes/fixes made in 0.1.08:

- All non mini-boss enemies have had their audio updated.

- Slither Worm mechanic change: 
---Now leaves a poison trail behind it as it moves around the area. Crossing this trail will poison the player (unless rolled over)

- Melee Spider mechanic change: 
--- Bite animation has been removed. 
--- "Leg stab" has been put in place. 
--- Spider now "skitters" across the area, moving in a more aggressive fashion. 
--- Speed has been increased.

- Wolf Pup mechanic change: 
--- Wolf pup no longer "breaths fire". In place is a fire well that persists on the ground for a set amount of time. This will "burn" the player if touched (but not if rolled through).

- Zombies now have a randomizer for their movement animation times. This should make multiple spawns not look they are walking/running in unison.

- Wolf Mini Boss mechanic change: 
---Now Enrages at less that 25% health causing it to spawn more pups and surround itself with wire. Being bit in this state will burn the player.

- Maggot Mini Boss mechanic change:
--- Tentacle Whip replaced with Claw Swipe
--- Spawns 3 maggots when vomiting instead of 1
--- When vomiting, a poison mass is spawned. This mass will expand and persist for a set amount of time. Touching this mass will poison the player (unless rolled over) 

- Address some reports of "breath" attacks going through large obstacles.
- Test fix for "Rolling" issue. User reports stating that sometimes the player cannot change weapon, shoot or reload after rolling.

Again, thank you so much for all of your support, suggestions and queries. You input has been incredibly appreciated!

notes.title: The Caretaker Changelog 0.1.07
notes.content:
Good Evening All,

The previously implemented User Bug Reports in game have been insanely useful allowing me to get to the root of issue(s) so much faster. Many thanks for using this feature.

Below are the changes/fixes made in 0.1.07:

- Shotgun now properly "spreads" its shot and can now hit multiple targets
- Shotgun damage reduced to allocate new "spreading" functionality
- Leaderboard Scores now display a few seconds after death. This is to test a theory that scores were being displayed before STEAM registered the new score update.

Again, thank you so much for all of your support, suggestions and queries. You input has been incredibly appreciated!

notes.title: The Caretaker Changelog 0.1.06
notes.content:
Good Evening All,

I've been working my tail off getting through all of your suggestions, issues and bugs from the current Play Test build. 

Below are the changes/fixes made:

- Re-work of the Spider Mini Boss mechanics
- Fixes for the Worm Mini Boss mechanics
- Reloading now works properly when Pressing the "Reload" key
- Added a "Join Discord" Button on the Main Menu at the suggestion of many.
- Turned off the player flashlight upon death to remove "God Rays" into the Camera
- Jumping spiders no longer try to poison you when they don't have line of sight.
- Fix to the "Turn and shoot" issue. Player will now fire in the correct direction when stopping and shooting
- Fixed the Cursor staying on "?" in the reported areas.
- Fixed players not being able to submit their scores to the leaderboard
- Added empty gun "Click" SFX when the player has no ammo
- Test Fix for "Reloading" bug that was stopping players from shooting after reloading
- Fixed no spawn issue after Horde wave would finish in Backyard, Power Plant and Warpit.
- Fixed exploding items not playing their SFX when going "boom"
- Added a "BUG REPORTING FORM" in game. Use "F12" to open the form. Submitting this will allow me to better diagnose performance issues that you may encounter.

Phew! That's all for now. 

Again, thank you so much for all of your support, suggestions and queries. You input has been incredibly appreciated!
